input.quote: TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Client does have a convenience exit (service continues to the end of the following month, i.e. 30–60 days) and TrueLink has no mid-term convenience right, so we are within our fallback. It falls short of the preferred position because the notice period is indeterminate (up to two months) and there is no refund of prepaid fees; we set 30 days' notice without penalty and added a pro-rata refund.

input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: The renewal term (12 months) and the 30-day non-renewal window meet our preferred position, but the price protection in Section 6 expires after the first year, so renewal pricing is uncapped and there is no renewal reminder. We added a 60-day reminder and capped renewal increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
